name: Web Proxy & Egress Traffic Intelligence
description: Web proxy traffic monitoring tracking allowed and blocked egress traffic, high-volume HTTP transactions, and egress destinations.

queries.current_sql: SELECT count(*) AS metric_value FROM %catalog.proxy_logs WHERE log_date BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts
queries.previous_sql: SELECT count(*) AS metric_value FROM %catalog.proxy_logs WHERE log_date BETWEEN :prev_start_ts AND :prev_end_ts
queries.sparkline_sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', log_date) AS bucket_ts, count(*) AS metric_value FROM %catalog.proxy_logs WHERE log_date BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts GROUP BY date_trunc('day', log_date)

queries.sql: SELECT action AS label, count(*) AS value FROM %catalog.proxy_logs WHERE log_date BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts GROUP BY action

SELECT dest_ip_latitude AS lat, dest_ip_longitude AS lon, count(*) AS count FROM %catalog.proxy_logs WHERE log_date BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts AND dest_ip_latitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dest_ip_latitude, dest_ip_longitude
SELECT src_ip, dest_ip, url_domain, action, bytes, status, http_method FROM %catalog.proxy_logs WHERE log_date BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts
